subunit: Interacts with MARK1, MARK2, MARK3 and MARK4. Interacts with PSMC2 through SQSTM1. Interacts with SQSTM1 when polyubiquitinated. Interacts with FKBP4. Binds to CSNK1D. Interacts with SGK1. Interacts with EPM2A; the interaction dephosphorylates MAPT at Ser-396. Interacts with PIN1. Interacts with LRRK2. Interacts with LRP1, leading to endocytosis; this interaction is reduced in the presence of LRPAP1/RAP
